experiment.policy: Hybrid V2: launch-feasibility gate plus voyage abort on attacker capital critical plus pre-launch hold while critical

metricSemantics.primaryUnit: Unique actual launch, keyed by seed plus stable operationId.
metricSemantics.capitalStateSampling: The cached canonical capital-defense assessment visible to amphibious launch decisions at each fast tick. State is sampled immediately before that tick's fast update; compact intervals are decision-time intervals, not inferred combat state.
metricSemantics.previousWindowConvention: Lookback windows contain ticks [launchTick - N, launchTick - 1]. The launch tick is reported separately.
metricSemantics.recentCritical: At least one canonical CRITICAL tick in the stated pre-launch lookback window.
metricSemantics.criticalRecovery: A THREATENED launch whose current threatened interval directly followed a CRITICAL interval. Recovery age is launchTick minus the first threatened decision tick.
metricSemantics.stableLabels: STABLE means no capital-state transition in the stated diagnostic window. Windows are analysis labels only, not gameplay constants.
metricSemantics.beachheadEstablished: True only for an original landing operation whose final beachheadOutcome is success; reinforcement arrivals are not counted as newly established beachheads.
metricSemantics.campaignCompleted: Final observed status of the campaign linked by originOperationId or bridgeheadCampaignId; null when no campaign was established/linked.
metricSemantics.rightCensored: Launched operation still active at the 3200-tick horizon; it is not counted as a failure.
metricSemantics.candidateRules: Decision-level observational filters over realized launches. Counts are not counterfactual world outcomes because vetoing a launch could change later world state and future operations.
